action_groups.title: Scoring and possession use
action_groups.summary: Made scoring uses the role-sharing templates below. Misses and turnovers use the calculation's reduced accountability coefficients.

actions.label: Self-created field goal: scorer
actions.explanation: The scorer receives 80%; the policy remainder is 20%.

actions.label: Assisted field goal: scorer
actions.explanation: The scorer receives 60% and the recorded passer receives 30%.

actions.label: Assisted field goal: passer
actions.explanation: The recorded assist receives 30% of the basket's face value.

actions.label: Missed 2-pointer
actions.explanation: Applies 50% accountability when the miss remains causal.

actions.label: Missed 3-pointer
actions.explanation: Applies 35% accountability when the miss remains causal.

actions.label: Turnover
actions.explanation: An identified turnover actor receives 80% accountability.

action_groups.title: Defense and recovery
action_groups.summary: These coefficients price possession changes and defensive stops; defended field goals use the separate location table.

actions.label: Named steal
actions.explanation: Credits the identified player for creating the change of possession.

actions.label: Exact block
actions.explanation: Uses a fixed 80% coefficient, not a location-specific block table.

actions.label: Uncontested defensive rebound
actions.explanation: The player-game contested rate blends this with the contested endpoint.

actions.label: Contested defensive rebound
actions.explanation: The contested endpoint is 20% of expected possession value.

actions.label: Pressure defense
actions.explanation: Applies to each identified defender for covered pressure violations.

actions.label: Offensive-rebound completion pool
actions.explanation: The pool goes to the recorded rebounder(s), never the original shooter.

action_groups.title: Fouls, free throws, and helpers
action_groups.summary: Free-throw scoring uses the same explicit role templates as field goals; fouls and helper transfers use recorded actors.

actions.label: Regular free-throw shortfall
actions.explanation: Assigns 80% of a surviving shortfall to the legal shooter.

actions.label: Identified fouler
actions.explanation: The identified defender receives the full applicable foul penalty.

actions.label: Free-throw assister
actions.explanation: The recorded passer receives 30% when the trip is assisted.

actions.label: Offensive boxout
actions.explanation: Transfers 25% of the existing OREB pool to the boxout player.

actions.label: Uncontested defensive boxout
actions.explanation: Transfers 50% of the rebound pool without creating new team value.

actions.label: Contested defensive boxout
actions.explanation: Transfers 25% of the rebound pool without creating new team value.
